default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1058.title: Same-clock drift sign
E-1058.hypothesis: Some minutes of the session show a repeatable drift (scheduled flows, fixings, routine order slicing); the 20-session mean bar return at this clock minute, relative to its typical size, gives the side.

E-1059.title: Gap held at the prior close
E-1059.hypothesis: After a gap the prior close is where gap-fill traders step in; a dip to it that closes back on the gap side shows the fill was refused, so the gap direction resumes.

E-1060.title: Heavy-volume small-range absorption at the extreme
E-1060.hypothesis: Large volume with a narrow range at a fresh session extreme means passive orders absorb the aggressors; the aggressors are trapped and the price turns.

E-1061.title: Narrowest-range bar break (NR-N)
E-1061.hypothesis: The narrowest bar of the last N bars marks a coil; the close beyond it releases stored volatility in that direction (Crabel NR4/NR7).

E-1062.title: Return autocorrelation regime
E-1062.hypothesis: Where recent bar returns are positively autocorrelated, orders are being sliced and the last bar's direction continues; where negative, bid-ask bounce dominates and it reverts.

E-1063.title: EMA ribbon alignment onset
E-1063.hypothesis: When three EMAs (f, 2f, 4f) first line up in order, the trend is broad across horizons and trend followers join; follow.

E-1064.title: Trend-day structure break reversal
E-1064.hypothesis: On a day already trending beyond its usual size, a close beyond the recent counter-side extreme shows the trend holders giving up and late trend chasers are trapped.

E-1065.title: Indecision cluster break
E-1065.hypothesis: Several small-body bars in a row mean buyers and sellers are balanced; the close beyond the cluster shows which side gave way.

E-1066.title: VWAP hug then departure
E-1066.hypothesis: Price hugging the session VWAP means the fair value is agreed; the first close outside a thin band after a long hug shows a new imbalance, so follow it.

E-1067.title: Dual-anchor cross follow
E-1067.hypothesis: Prior close and today's open are the two reference prices; a close beyond both means everyone who bought or sold since yesterday is in profit or loss together, so the move follows.
